title: Evaluation of the three-literal conversion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\psi$ be a conjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables whose width is at most $3$, and let $x$ be an assignment to those variables together with three additional sign variables. The formula obtained by the specified three-literal conversion evaluates to $-1$ on $x$ if and only if $\psi$ evaluates to $-1$ on the restriction of $x$ to its original $n$ variables.
hypotheses_covered: A conjunctive normal form on $n$ variables
